subject: QuickSell: onboarding benchmark consolidation & runbook deposit
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, ops@quicksell.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: QuickSell: onboarding benchmark consolidation & runbook deposit

Hi team,

Following handoff from Sales, attaching the canonical artifacts for QuickSell's onboarding benchmark. QuickSell's acceptance depends on the latency and throughput SLAs below — please review and propose an execution window.

Acceptance summary (customer-facing):
- Sustained throughput: 50 req/s (concurrent inference requests using their mult-turn chat profile) for 30 minutes
- Median generation latency: P50 < 120 ms
- Tail constraints: P95 < 220 ms, P99 < 420 ms
- Error rate: < 0.5% (5xx/timeout)
- Token budget: 150 tokens average per request (their representative payload)

Notes for the runbook:
- Model variant to use: rwd-7b-v2 (float16) with kv-cache warmup; if resource limits occur, fallback to rwd-7b-q4f for cost/latency comparison.
- Load profile attached: quicksell_load_profile_v1.json includes arrival pattern, session ramp, and two traffic mixes (peak and baseline).
- Please run baseline (50 req/s) first, then a 90-minute soak at 30 req/s, and capture token-level telemetry and KV cache hit rates.

Attachments I've dropped to the shared Drive and attached here: redwood_runbook_quicksell_v1.pdf (runbook + acceptance checklist), quicksell_load_profile_v1.json, quicksell_benchmark_script_v1.zip. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cxyz-redwood-quicksell

Action items:
- Monica/Ben: propose two 2-hour windows next week for the live runs (include time for artifacts review and smoke test).
- Ben: confirm which infra (dedicated vs hosted) we'll schedule the runs on and whether we need a temporary higher burst for the 30-minute peak.
- Monica: coordinate with QuickSell ops (cc'd) to provide test credentials and ephemeral test endpoint.

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Account Executive (Onboarding Lead)
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Anya Patel <anya@quicksell.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuickSell: onboarding benchmark consolidation & runbook deposit

Thanks Markus — copied the runbook and load profile. A few clarifications before we schedule:

1) Traffic mix breakdown: the load file calls out a 70/30 split between short chat prompts and multi-turn flows. Can QuickSell confirm the percent of authenticated vs anonymous flows? That affects cache priming.
2) Token distribution: the runbook uses 150 tokens avg; please confirm the 95th percentile token length so we can model tail memory pressure.
3) Infra preference: based on similar accounts, I'd recommend running the acceptance on a small Dedicated pool (2xA100 equivalent) to avoid noisy neighbor risk during the P95/P99 capture. If Sales needs hosted for contractual reasons we can simulate but will note noise in the report.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tuesday 21 May, 10:00–12:00 (smoke + baseline + one peak)
- Wednesday 22 May, 09:00–11:00 (full baseline + 90-min soak)

Ben — can you confirm resource availability and whether the test harness in quicksell_benchmark_script_v1.zip needs updates to emit KV cache tags?

Anya — can you provide: test credentials, expected percent authenticated, and the 95th percentile token size? If you prefer a different window, we can be flexible.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Anya Patel <anya@quicksell.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@quicksell.com
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 14:25:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: QuickSell: onboarding benchmark consolidation & runbook deposit

Monica, Markus — thanks for the clear runbook. Quick responses below: 

- Authenticated vs anonymous: ~85% authenticated (most traffic comes from logged-in sessions), 15% anonymous.
- Token distribution: 95th percentile ~420 tokens (there are some long context chains for customer support scenarios).
- Test credentials: I created a time-limited test key (test_key_quicksell_202805) and a sandbox endpoint at https://sandbox.quicksell.com/redwood-test. Credentials in a separate secure note — ops@quicksell.com will DM the team.
- Preference: fine with Dedicated pool for the main acceptance run; we'd like the initial smoke to happen on Hosted to check integration.

We can do Tuesday 21 May, 10:00–12:00 for the smoke + baseline + a lightweight peak, and Wednesday 22 May, 09:00–11:00 for soak/acceptance. If you need more time for the 90-minute soak, we can extend Wed to 11:30.

I've asked LoadLabs (testing vendor) to stand by for data collection — they will ingest telemetry and provide an independent run-results CSV. Contact there: loadlab@testing.co.

— Anya
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
QuickSell

On Fri, May 17, 2028 at 12:03 PM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Markus — copied the runbook and load profile...
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Anya Patel <anya@quicksell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, ops@quicksell.com
Date: Sun, 19 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuickSell: onboarding benchmark consolidation & runbook deposit

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmations, Anya. Plan confirmed:

- Tue 2028-05-21 10:00–12:00 PST: Hosted smoke + baseline + light peak (capture HV/EV)
- Wed 2028-05-22 09:00–11:30 PST: Dedicated acceptance run (50 req/s sustained 30m + 90-min soak at 30 req/s)

Ben: please provision the Dedicated pool and post the infra IDs to the Drive folder by EOD Monday. Also make sure quicksell_benchmark_script_v1.zip emits KV cache tags and per-request request_id so LoadLabs can correlate traces.

Monica: I'll be present for the Wed soak. Laura, please prepare the acceptance artifact template (we usually include per-run P50/P95/P99, error histogram, token distribution, CPU/GPU utilization, and a short conclusion on whether acceptance gates were met). Attach the vendor CSV (run-results-20280515.csv) after LoadLabs uploads it; we'll embed it in the final evidence packet.

When the runs are complete, we'll produce a single consolidated artifact (redwood_runbook_quicksell_v1.pdf + run-results csv + an executive one-pager) and request signoff from Anya + Ops.

I'll move the Drive folder to the QuickSell onboarding space and update the HubSpot deal (QCK-4321).

Thanks all — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Account Executive (Onboarding Lead)
Redwood Inference
